title: Readers’ Rides: Gandolf,  Shane’s 1991 Specialized Stumpjumper
content:
A 90s Stumpjumper might as well be a gravel bike. Shane thinks so too. And for this week’s Readers’ Rides, we’re checking out his 1991 Stumpjumper drop bar build!

I’d love to submit my bike, “Gandolf,” for your Readers’ Rides feature.

Gandolf is a 1991 Specialized Stumpjumper Comp 20″, and it was my first mountain bike. I bought it when I was riding the Hill Country around my home in Texas, never imagining how much of my life this bike would eventually see.

I later joined the Navy, and because my ship was a pre-commissioning unit that sailed from Bath, Maine, through the Panama Canal and eventually to San Diego, I was able to keep my bike in the helo hanger. That gave Gandolf an opportunity to travel almost as much as I did. Over the years I rode it in Maine, New Hampshire, Rhode Island, Massachusetts, Florida, Texas, Mexico, Panama, Colombia, and elsewhere in South America.

Eventually, though, I had newer bikes sitting in the garage and realized I wasn’t riding my old stumpy anymore. I felt a little guilty about that. It had been such an important part of my life that I didn’t want to see it become a garage ornament.

So I decided to give it a second life.

I worked with a local builder to convert the Stumpjumper into my go-to gravel bike. I also tracked down someone in Europe who could recreate the original vinyl decals, and of course Gandolf needed a custom badge to finish it off.

The result is probably my favorite bike I’ve ever owned. It still looks and feels like the old Stumpjumper that carried me through my early mountain-bike years, but now it’s a bike I actually ride all the time. Instead of preserving it as a piece of nostalgia, I get to keep adding miles and stories to it.

Build Spec:

  • Frame/Fork: 1991 Specialized Stumpjumper Comp 20″, Direct Drive Tange Prestige
  • Rims: Velocity Cliffhanger Black 32H, 27.5″
  • Hubs: SRAM 900, front 15/12/QR x 100mm 32H; rear SRAM 900 32H, 6-bolt Disc XDR 11/12 27.8mm Driver
  • Tires: Ultradynamico ROSE Race 650b
  • Handlebars: Salsa Cowchipper
  • Headset: Ritchey Logic Comp 1-1/8″ threadless, 30mm spacers, black
  • Crankset: SRAM GX, 175mm Boost
  • Cassette: SRAM XG-1275 GX Eagle, 10-52t, 12-speed
  • Rear Derailleur: SRAM SX Eagle, 12-speed, long cage
  • Brakes: BR-T4000 V-Brakes
  • Shifter: Gevenalle 1×12 GX-compatible, long pull
  • Saddle: Brooks B17 Standard, antique brown
  • Seatpost: Post Modern
  • Stem: Cannondale Three, black TIG, 10-degree alloy wedge
  • Pedals: RaceFace Chester
  • Front Bag: Roadrunner Middle Earth Jammer
  • Rear Bags: Roadrunner Drafter Liters
  • Other Accessories: Blackburn Outpost Cargo Cage, 15″ Voile Straps
